The company was founded by [[T. K. Gajjar]], A. S. Kotibhaskar and B. D. Amin.{{Cite web|title=Alembic History {{!}} Alembic Information|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/alembic-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-31.cms|access-date=2021-12-24|website=The Economic Times}} It is one of the oldest industrial houses in [[India]] and has a diversified portfolio of business.{{cite web|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/alembic-launches-realty-project-in-bengaluru-114111401680_1.html |title= Alembic launches realty project in Bengaluru – Business Standard. |date= 14 November 2014|accessdate=28 March 2017}} Their major businesses include, [[pharmaceuticals]], [[healthcare]], [[engineering]], [[chemicals]] and [[glassware]] production. In 2014–2015, the market cap of Alembic Group was ₹9,578 crore while its turnover was ₹2,200 crore.{{cite web|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/alembic-launches-realty-project-in-bengaluru-114111401680_1.html |title= Alembic launches realty project in Bengaluru – Business Standard. |date= 14 November 2014|accessdate=28 March 2017}} ==History== Alembic Group initially began with primary focus on production of [[tinctures]], [[alcohol (drug)|alcohol]], [[vitamins]], [[penicillin]], and eventually [[Active ingredient|active pharmaceutical ingredients]] (API) thus majorly having a brief focus on the [[pharmaceutical]] business. However, in 2010, the group demerged its [[pharmaceutical]] business, thereby making it to be separate entity called [[Alembic Pharmaceuticals Ltd]].{{cite web|url=http://www.forbesindia.com/article/super-50-companies-2016/how-the-amin-family-scions-changed-alembics-fortunes/43951/1|title= How the Amin family scions changed Alembic's fortunes – Forbes India.|date=|access-date=28 March 2017}} ==Subsidiaries== This section lists the various businesses under Alembic Group. ===Pharmaceutical=== The [[Alembic Pharmaceuticals Ltd]]. is a public listed company belonging to the Alembic Group. It is involved in manufacture of [[pharmaceutical]] substances, [[pharmaceutical products]] and intermediates.{{cite web|url=http://profit.ndtv.com/stock/alembic-pharmaceuticals-ltd_aplltd/reports|title= Alembic Pharma Reports - NDTVProfit.com.|date=|access-date=28 March 2017}} ===Real estate=== Alchemy Real Estate is the real estate arm of Alembic Group and is involved in developing residential townships, [[Physical plant|industrial plants]], [[school]]s, [[Office|commercial offices]] and [[hospital]]s majorly in the state of [[Gujarat]]. In November 2014, Alchemy Real Estate launched its first project in the city of [[Bangalore|Bengaluru]] – [[Karnataka]].{{cite news|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/Alembic-group-forays-into-Bengalurus-real-estate-market/articleshow/45193221.cms|title= Alembic group forays into Bengaluru's real estate market – The Times of India.|website= [[The Times of India]]|date=18 November 2014|access-date=28 March 2017}} ===Glassware=== Shreno Ltd. formerly known as Alembic Glass Industries Ltd. is a business of Alembic Group dedicated to glassware manufacturing.{{cite web|url=https://www.glassonweb.com/directory/shreno-ltd-glass-division|title= Glass on Web – Directory.|date=|access-date=28 March 2017}} Shreno Ltd. is involved in manufacture of table [[glassware]] under its brand name {{proper name|Yera Glassware}}.{{cite web|url=http://www.indiacatalog.com/web_directory/wd_detail.php?id=6627|title= Yera [Shreno Ltd] : Glass Division – India Catalog.|date=|access-date=28 March 2017}}{{cite web|url=http://www.financialexpress.com/archive/we-help-people-become-self-reliant-through-their-own-efforts/211185/|title= We help people become self-reliant through their own efforts – Financial Express.|date=4 November 2014|access-date=28 March 2017}} ===Philanthropy=== ====Schools==== The Alembic Group through its Uday Education Trust has established Alembic Group of Schools. The group has five schools which aid in providing affordable and high quality education to children based in [[Vadodara]] and [[Bangalore|Bangaluru]]. Amin Memorial School, [[Vadodara]] * Utkarsh Vidyalaya, [[Vadodara]] * Tejas Vidyalaya, [[Vadodara]] * Alembic Vidyalaya, [[Vadodara]] ====Hospitals==== Alembic Group has established Bhailal Amin General Hospital (BAGH), a tertiary care multi-specialty [[hospital]] in [[Vadodara]]. BAGH is the only hospital approved by the state and [[Government of India|the central government of India]] to conduct cardiac treatment, [[Cardiac surgery|surgery]], [[Kidney transplantation|kidney transplants]]/surgery and [[cadaver]] transplants.{{cite web|url=http://www.financialexpress.com/archive/we-help-people-become-self-reliant-through-their-own-efforts/211185/|title= We help people become self-reliant through their own efforts – Financial Express.|date=4 November 2014|access-date=28 March 2017}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== * {{Official website | http://www.alembiclimited.com}} [[Category:Pharmaceutical industry in Gujarat]] [[Category:Pharmaceutical industry in India| ]] [[Category:Companies based in Vadodara]] [[Category:Chemical companies established in 1907]] [[Category:Conglomerate companies established in 1907]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1907]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] {{med-company-stub}}
extract: Alembic Group is an Indian conglomerate headquartered in Vadodara. It was founded in 1907 and was initially known as Alembic Chemical Works Company Ltd. The company was founded by T. K. Gajjar, A. S. Kotibhaskar and B. D. Amin. It is one of the oldest industrial houses in India and has a diversified portfolio of business. Their major businesses include, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, engineering, chemicals and glassware production. In 2014–2015, the market cap of Alembic Group was ₹9,578 crore while its turnover was ₹2,200 crore.
